prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D RPG overworld sprite asset for PipaKlub Morro do Sol, a warm Brazilian hillside neighborhood. Image 1 is STYLE authority for crisp chibi game proportions, dark clean outlines and chunky cel-shaded color clusters. Image 2 is SUBJECT/PALETTE reference only: warm plaster, terracotta, teal doors, lush green vegetation. Do not reproduce its isometric perspective. Camera strictly orthographic top-down three-quarter RPG, front facade straight horizontal, vertical walls vertical on page, top surface visible, NO isometric diagonally skewed footprint, no vanishing point. Lighting from upper left. Hand drawn 2D sprite aesthetic, simplified readable shapes at small game scale, no photorealism, no 3D render, no characters, no UI, no text or watermark. Asset type: modular architecture sprite atlas. Exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, equal cells, generous transparent margin inside EVERY cell. TOP LEFT: one wide single-storey pastel yellow plaster facade, teal shutter windows and doorway, frontal straight facade, exposed flat top edge, NO roof and NO projecting side wall. TOP RIGHT: a separate broad terracotta tile roof cap viewed from above, rectangular footprint, horizontal ridgeline, to layer above that house; no facade. BOTTOM LEFT: one salmon pink plaster facade with teal window, narrow balcony railing and doorway, NO roof, straight horizontal base. BOTTOM RIGHT: a separate blue wooden double gate with two cream masonry pillars, front view. All four sprites isolated from one another, no objects crossing cell boundaries, no cast ground shadow. True alpha background. This is a reusable production atlas, not a presentation board. Match proportional door height across facades. No label, border, background or scenery.
